title: Vuemantics
subtitle: Semantic image & video search using local AI and vector embeddings
description:
I built this to actually understand how semantic search works, not just call an API and hope for the best. The idea came from frustration with Apple Photos. It's 2025 and if I search 'friend in black jacket' it finds nothing useful because it's still just matching text metadata. Meanwhile I can build actual semantic search myself? Something felt wrong about that gap.

The bigger shift from my original version: I ripped out Gemini and OpenAI entirely. Everything runs locally through Ollama now — Qwen2.5-VL for vision analysis and bge-m3 for embeddings. No API costs, no data leaving the machine, and honestly the results are comparable for personal media search.
technical_details:
The architecture chains two local AI models together via Ollama, each doing what it's good at. Qwen2.5-VL handles vision, analyzing uploaded images and videos to generate detailed text descriptions. Those descriptions get fed to bge-m3 which converts them into 1024-dimensional vectors. The vectors live in PostgreSQL via pgvector, and similarity search happens through cosine distance calculations.

Images go through a preprocessing step before hitting the vision model — dimension alignment to the nearest multiple of 28px (Qwen2.5-VL's patch size), scaling, EXIF correction, and format optimization. Skipping this caused GGML assertion failures that were annoying to debug.

```python
# Dimension alignment for Qwen2.5-VL patch size (28px grid)
new_width = (width // patch_size) * patch_size
new_height = (height // patch_size) * patch_size
new_width = max(new_width, patch_size)
new_height = max(new_height, patch_size)
```

Videos get frame-extracted via OpenCV, each frame analyzed individually (Qwen2.5-VL has a multi-image bug), then a synthesis prompt combines the frame descriptions into a cohesive video description.

Search queries go through the same bge-m3 embedding process. You type 'sunset at the beach', that text becomes a 1024-dim vector, and pgvector finds the images whose description vectors are closest via cosine distance.

```python
# Query text becomes a vector, pgvector finds nearest neighbors
query_embedding = await local_ai_service.create_embedding_for_query(query)
results = await Upload.search_by_embedding(
    query_embedding=query_embedding,
    user_id=user_id,
    similarity_threshold=request.similarity_threshold,
    use_local=True,
)
```

After the vision model generates a description, it runs through a DescriptionAuditor before the embedding step. The auditor checks for hallucination signals: model control tokens leaking into output, low word diversity, consecutive word repetition, and high non-alphabetic character ratios. Failed audits trigger a retry before falling back and logging the quality score.

```python
audit_result = DescriptionAuditor.audit(description)
if not audit_result.passed and attempt < max_retries - 1:
    # Retry vision analysis before accepting low-quality description
    continue
```

The backend is FastAPI with fully async processing. Uploads return immediately (201) while a background task handles the Qwen2.5-VL → bge-m3 → pgvector pipeline. Real-time progress streams to the client via WebSocket backed by Redis pub/sub — so if you're watching the upload, you see stage transitions (queued → vision analysis → description audit → embedding → indexing) with a quality score at the end.

I went with raw asyncpg instead of an ORM because pgvector needs a custom type codec registered at the connection level.

```python
# Custom vector codec for asyncpg
await conn.set_type_codec(
    "vector",
    encoder=lambda v: f"[{','.join(map(str, v))}]",
    decoder=lambda v: list(map(float, v[1:-1].split(","))),
    schema="public",
)
```

async def analyze_media(self, upload_id: UUID) -> None:
    upload = await Upload.find_by_id(upload_id)
    if not upload:
        return

    await upload.update_status(ProcessingStatus.ANALYZING)
    await self._publish_progress(upload_id, ProcessingStatus.ANALYZING,
        ProcessingStage.QUEUED, 0, "Starting AI analysis")

    description = None
    audit_result = None

    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        await self._publish_progress(upload_id, ProcessingStatus.ANALYZING,
            ProcessingStage.VISION_ANALYSIS, 20,
            f"Analyzing {upload.file_type} with vision model")

        # Local vision model (Qwen2.5-VL via Ollama)
        if upload.file_type == "image":
            description = await self._vision.analyze_image(file_path)
        else:
            description = await self._analyze_video_with_frames(
                upload.user_id, upload_id, file_path
            )

        # Audit for hallucinations before accepting
        audit_result = DescriptionAuditor.audit(description)
        if audit_result.passed:
            break

    await upload.update_status(ProcessingStatus.EMBEDDING)
    await self._publish_progress(upload_id, ProcessingStatus.EMBEDDING,
        ProcessingStage.EMBEDDING_GENERATION, 60, "Generating embeddings",
        audit_score=audit_result.score)

    # Local embedding model (bge-m3 via Ollama, 1024-dim)
    embedding = await self._embedding.generate_embedding(description)

    await upload.update_analysis(
        description=description,
        embedding=embedding,
        use_local=True,
        description_audit_score=audit_result.score,
    )
